description:
Casement puts your Mac or Windows PC on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Vision Pro. See its screen, sharp and fast, and control it as if you were sitting in front of it.

Casement connects your own devices directly, over your own Tailscale network. There's no Casement account, no relay server, no ads, and no tracking. It's free and open source.

WHAT YOU NEED
• Casement Host, a free companion app, running on the computer you want to control. It's available for Mac (macOS 26 or later) and for Windows 10 and 11 at github.com/dlev02/Casement/releases.
• Tailscale on the computer and on this device, signed in to the same tailnet. Tailscale's free plan works.

A SHARP, RESPONSIVE PICTURE
• Hardware HEVC or H.264 video, tuned for low latency, with accurate color.
• Bitrate and frame rate adapt to your connection, so text stays crisp and motion stays smooth.
• A Mac can show a virtual display shaped like your iPad, with BetterDisplay installed.

CONTROL IT NATURALLY
• iPhone and iPad: Trackpad or Direct Touch, two- and three-finger clicks, scrolling with momentum, Apple Pencil, and a hardware keyboard, mouse, or trackpad. Push the pointer into a screen edge or corner and the Mac's Dock, menu bar, and hot corners respond.
• Mac: each computer opens in its own window. Your keyboard shortcuts go through, and full screen really is full screen.
• Apple Vision Pro: look and pinch, in windows that keep the computer's shape.
• A control strip you can customize for each computer, with Mission Control, Spotlight, Show Desktop, and the modifier keys, or Start, Task View, and Task Manager on a PC. Drag it to any corner or collapse it.

MOVE FILES BOTH WAYS
Drop files onto the screen, open them in Casement from another app, or send them from the device list without opening the screen at all. Large transfers pick up where they stopped after a dropped connection and keep going after you disconnect.

HEAR YOUR MAC
Stream your Mac's sound to your device with low latency.

DICTATE
Speak and Casement types for you, transcribed on your device or on your Mac.

SHARE THE CLIPBOARD
Text, rich text, and images. What you copy on the computer arrives on your device. Your device's clipboard is sent only when you ask.

GET INTO A LOCKED MAC
Type your saved password where macOS blocks typing, such as the lock screen, through the Mac's own Screen Sharing. Casement Host can also stop an accidental restart while you're connected.

FITS RIGHT IN
Siri and Shortcuts ("Connect to Studio in Casement"), Spotlight, an app lock with Face ID, Touch ID, or Optic ID, and iCloud Keychain sync for saved passwords. On iPhone and iPad, Home Screen widgets and a Control Center control.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything travels directly between your devices inside Tailscale's encrypted tunnel. Each device has its own key and pairs once, with a six-digit code shown on the computer. Casement collects no data.

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
Casement is free, with no subscriptions or in-app purchases. Its source code is published under the GNU General Public License, version 3, at github.com/dlev02/Casement.

Tailscale is a trademark of Tailscale Inc., and Windows is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation. Casement isn't affiliated with or endorsed by either.
promotionalText: Control your Mac or Windows PC from iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Vision Pro, privately over your own Tailscale network. Free and open source, with no account or tracking.
